comment: GenAI emulator configuration. 'models' drives the node's Model enum and per-model capability gating exactly as a real service's config would: give each model its real id plus whatever caps that service enforces (here max_seconds and tokens_per_frame). 'service' tunes the pipeline: gen_seconds is the emulator's pretend generation time; tunnel is 'auto' (use cloudflared when available, else a direct localhost URL - fine for the local emulator, required for a real remote service), 'on' (fail if unavailable), or 'off'.
